# 2 Baruch Chapter 69 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** The Cloud and Waters Vision

---

**69:1** "And-those-bright-waters which-you-saw after-those-black-waters: these-are-those-who-lived-righteously in-the-time-of-the-captivity."

**69:2** "For-there-were-many-among-them who-did-not-abandon the-law, and-who-clung-to-the-commandments, and-who-did-not-forget-the-fear-of-the-Mighty-One."

**69:3** "For-they-were-a-fountain-of-light in-the-darkness; and-they-were-a-lamp-in-a-strange-land; and-they-were-a-refuge in-the-time-of-trouble."

**69:4** "And-among-them-was-Ezekiel the-great-prophet, and-also-others who-were-like-him."

**69:5** "These-are-the-seventh-bright-waters which-you-saw."

---

*EMET notes: Translated from the Syriac (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1). Hyphenated compounds preserve construct chains. Bracketed words [thus] are implied by grammar but absent from the surface text.*
